allow: Bash(powershell -Command "$response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ''http://localhost:11000/api/historical/BTCUSDT?interval=1&days=1'' -UseBasicParsing; $json = $response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host ''Total velas:'' $json.total_candles; Write-Host ''Esperadas:'' $json.requested_candles; Write-Host ''Primera vela:'' $json.data[0].datetime_colombia; Write-Host ''Ultima vela:'' $json.data[-1].datetime_colombia; Write-Host ''In progress ultima:'' $json.data[-1].in_progress")
